title: Gluing module isomorphisms on disjoint opens
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], I a small (Type 0) type, and U_i pairwise disjoint open subsets covering X (including empty members). Let F,G be O_X-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. If their tensor pullbacks [def-pc-module-pullback] along every inclusion U_i -> X are isomorphic, then F and G are isomorphic. No finiteness or quasi-compactness condition is imposed; the empty cover of the empty scheme is included.

source.place: Tag 04TN (lemma-glue-maps) and its uniqueness clause; Tag 00AM (lemma-glue-sheaves-structures), compatibility with module structures.

proof.text: Compare tensor pullback along each U_i inclusion with sectionwise restriction, using uniqueness of left adjoints. Use Scheme.Modules.overFunctorEquiv and the fully faithful equivalence overEquiv to transport each chosen local isomorphism to the category of sheaves of modules on the localized Over U_i site.

For any open W contained in two distinct members, disjointness forces W empty. Uniqueness for the empty covering says all sections of a module on W agree, hence both local maps agree on W. For equal indices the agreement is reflexivity. This proves the overlap conditions for both the local forward and inverse maps.

Apply the morphism clause of glue_sheaves_of_modules to glue the forward maps and their inverses. Each composite restricts to an identity, so the uniqueness clause of the same theorem proves the two global inverse identities. Package the two maps as the required isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Tag 04TN (lemma-glue-maps) and its uniqueness clause; Tag 00AM (lemma-glue-sheaves-structures), compatibility with module structures.

lean.statement:
theorem disjointOpen_nonempty_iso {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type}
    (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ i : ι, x ∈ U i)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ (i j : ι) (x : X), x ∈ U i → x ∈ U j → i = j)
    (F G : X.Modules)
    (hlocal : ∀ i : ι,
      Nonempty ((tensorPullback (U i).ι).obj F ≅ (tensorPullback (U i).ι).obj G)) :
    Nonempty (F ≅ G)
